scope: Showcase art direction and intended contact charts. These are asset-specific production notes, not plugin defaults or automatic visual-quality scores.
route: Create a fresh single-animal design reference using built-in image generation.
Explore generated motion poses using the design reference and any explicit native pose guide.
Import selected generated design or motion pixels into Pixelorama at the chosen logical canvas; record the selected input honestly.
Inspect body identity, limb ownership, joints, foot contact, complete silhouettes, and the wrap transition; correct observed defects natively.
Save editable sources, export PNGs, encode GIFs, then independently reopen and compare sources/exports.

assets.detail_review: Three thin toe branches, transparent gaps between the forward tips, and a separate rear branch. Recovery toes fold. The original pale rounded belly rim overlaps the leg roots.
assets.selected_source_pixels: Detailed head/body pixels are retained from the first pose of the new generated motion sheet. The generated leg phases were replaced by a deliberately authored two-leg contact/recovery plan and native branched-toe corrections; the original rounded pale belly rim is retained.

assets.detail_review: Complete crest, beak, red cheek and vent, tail, wing feathers and roots. Inspect feet separately during tucked airborne and extended landing poses.
assets.selected_source_pixels: The eight newly generated crouch, push-off, flutter and landing poses supply the production artwork. Native alpha cleanup and explicit position/contact corrections stabilize the head anchor and actual body elevation.

assets.footfall_reference: LH -> LF -> RH -> RF; each limb tracks stance and swing separately. Walk has longer stance than swing and continuous support.
assets.selected_source_pixels: All detailed character pixels originate in the newly generated ginger-kitten design reference. Initial and extra generated motion sheets were rejected for inconsistent limb phases; none of their pixels were adopted. Native Pixelorama separated and articulated the actual reference limbs, preserved the fur at the roots, and authored local paw/whisker/occlusion corrections. No old public animal art or rejected geometric redraw was reused.

native_contact_convention.scope: This stylized asset projects near and far paws onto separate depth lines; this is not a plugin-wide rule.

assets.rejected_studies: Initial and guide-conditioned generated motion sheets were rejected; selected production pixels originate in the fresh design reference.

assets.footfall_reference: Near front with far hind, alternating with far front and near hind. Each hind limb must visibly recover, reach forward contact under the body, then move backward through stance.
assets.selected_source_pixels: Uses only the newly generated corgi design reference and a new guide-conditioned motion draft. No pixels from the replaced public animal artwork were reused. The guide was authored in an isolated native Pixelorama document.
assets.native_contact_convention: The project-specific motion guide chooses a single screen-space side-profile contact plane, last visible y112. This is not a generic criterion for perspective artwork; a different view may legitimately use different projected depth planes.

actual_phase_summary.support: Deliberate precontact hold, one pixel above contact plane
Next diagonal precontact, one pixel above contact plane

assets.precontact_hold: Failed generated pose3 excluded; pose4 supplies an explicit one-pixel-lifted precontact hold at frame3 before its grounded frame4. Other poses remain distinct generated whole-body drawings; frame7 anticipates contact one pixel above ground.
